## Build & Upload Limits

- **Total size:** ⚠️ Not published; verify in portal
- **Initial download:** 8 MB (target)
- **File count:** ⚠️ Not published; verify in portal
- **Max per-file:** ⚠️ Not published; verify in portal
- **Entry point:** index.html
- **Paths:** bundle all assets locally
- **External requests:** blocked by default; bundle everything (no Google Fonts, no CDN libs)
- **Compression:** server-side; Unity Compression Method = Disabled, never LZMA
- **Persistence:** localStorage wrapped in try/catch
- **Canvas:** 16:9; reference 640x360 / 836x470 / 1031x580; fill screen on mobile
- **Review:** validated via Poki Inspector before submission
